decision: Drop of 5 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
offence: Breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 b) of the International Sporting Code.
penalty: Drop of 5 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 97 (Robert Shwartzman), team representative and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, team radio and in-car video evidence. Following the incident at T9 Shwartzman passed a single waved yellow, and a double yellow flag before overtaking Tsunoda in the yellow zone while traveling at speed. The penalty is the usual penalty for passing under a double yellow, and while the Stewards recognize that the driver is not scheduled to start the race, they have applied the consistent penalty.
stewards: recognize that the driver is not scheduled to start the race
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
